# Mohit Singh — Graphic Designer

> Mohit Singh is a freelance graphic designer in India creating product packaging, e-commerce banners, social media creatives and logos for beauty, personal-care and pet-care brands.

Freelance graphic designer for beauty, personal-care and pet-care brands. I design product labels and packaging, e-commerce banners, social media campaigns and logos — taking a product from shelf-ready to launch-ready.

## Key facts

- Name: Mohit Singh
- Role: Freelance graphic designer
- Based in: India
- Availability: Available for freelance projects
- Email: mohitdhondial@gmail.com
- Website: https://mohitsingh.freegraha.in/
- Tools: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, AI tools
- Clients: Medimade Wellness, Coronation Herbal, Earthy Secrets, Mr. Jerry
- Portfolio size: 58 designs (17 web banners, 21 social media, 12 packaging, 8 logo design)

## Services

- **Packaging & label design**: Bottle, jar, soap-wrap and pet-care labels with print-ready files and photoreal product mockups.
- **E-commerce banner design**: Website hero banners, sale and launch campaigns, sized for Shopify, Amazon and marketplace storefronts.
- **Social media creatives**: Scroll-stopping product composites, benefit carousels and teaser posts for Instagram and Facebook.
- **Logo & brand identity**: Logos and wordmarks with the colour, type and usage rules a growing brand needs.

## How to hire

Email mohitdhondial@gmail.com with your product, the formats you need (packaging, banners, social posts or a logo) and your timeline.
Process: 1) share your brief, 2) review concepts and give feedback, 3) receive print-ready and web-ready files.

## FAQ

### Who is Mohit Singh?
Mohit Singh is a freelance graphic designer based in India. He designs product packaging, e-commerce banners, social media creatives and logos, mainly for beauty, personal-care and pet-care brands.

### What design services does Mohit Singh offer?
Four core services: packaging and label design, e-commerce and website banner design, social media creatives for Instagram and Facebook, and logo and brand identity design.

### Which brands has Mohit Singh designed for?
His portfolio includes work for Medimade Wellness (banners, campaigns and pet-care packaging), Coronation Herbal (skin and body-care packaging), Earthy Secrets (logo and social media campaigns) and Mr. Jerry Pet Grooming (logo).

### What tools does Mohit Singh use?
Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva and AI tools.

### How do I hire Mohit Singh for a design project?
Email mohitdhondial@gmail.com with your product, the formats you need (packaging, banners, social posts or a logo) and your timeline. He replies with ideas and a quote.

### What does a project with Mohit Singh look like?
Three steps: you share a brief (product, audience, sizes and deadline), you review first concepts and give feedback, then you receive final print-ready and web-ready files.
